R3A-grouse-atv-0001.name: By Downton Creek
R3A-grouse-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R3A-grouse-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Downton Creek FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Road: Downton Creek FSR, 4.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
39 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-16 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 91 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.54634, -122.25895, where the truck road ends (Downton Creek FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Downton Creek FSR stretch, 4.5 km one way. About 89 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-16, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-grouse-atv-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-16: about 1,029 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.34 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
